title: hieracium olivaceum subsp. rosulifolium
intro: Hieracium olivaceum subsp. rosulifolium, commonly known as Rosy-leaved Hawkweed, is a plant species within the dandelion-like flowering plants in the sunflower family. This plant is reported to have potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Rosy-leaved Hawkweed include modulating the immune system, antioxidant activity, and potential anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of Hieracium olivaceum subsp. rosulifolium include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects and potential uses.
